title: P8 numerical qualification campaign
objective: Build backend-neutral P0-P8 corpora, real Sage.js Node adapters, capability binding drafts, fail-closed matrix policy templates, and qualification tests without fabricating platform evidence

oracles: independent mathematical residuals and metamorphic identities computed outside solver status

handoff.summary: Advanced the source-bound P0-P8 Node qualification campaign to corpus v5: 39 backend-neutral cases and 26 available capabilities. Corrected the final multilingual catalog to 63 supported, 25 structured-unsupported, and 59 envelope-bound emitters; replaced stale unsafe MATLAB/Wolfram catalog witnesses; executed eleven built-MATLAB-parser programs for one-output and callback row/column shape; and fault-injected missing/corrupt cminpack optional resources through the real public least-squares artifact. Automatic least squares remains on independently checked ordinary Python while explicit cminpack returns stable nonleaking structured failure. A disposable dirty-lane full campaign passed all 39 cases; it is not a release receipt and no platform evidence was checked in.
risks: No final Node, SEA, browser, or worker platform receipt has been collected. Both matrix templates intentionally remain evidence-free and fail closed until the exact clean candidate is measured on each required host/runtime.

The cminpack case injects missing/corrupt failures at the built runtime's lazy backend state and checks the public least-squares result; browser fetch and corrupt-byte isolation remain separate browser qualification evidence.
The merged source currently has a stale optimizer-opportunity generated manifest, so architecture:check stops at that shared integration-owned check after all earlier architecture gates pass.
NLopt central integration was not yet present at the source closure and therefore has no capability or campaign case in corpus v5.
next_steps: After central NLopt integration lands, reactivate this lane, merge the new source closure, and add exact executable cases/capability envelopes for its public selection, fallback, cancellation, and resource semantics.
Refresh the shared optimizer-opportunity artifacts in the integration lane and rerun architecture:check.
Only after source freeze, bind fresh capability manifests and collect immutable clean receipts independently on every required Node, SEA, browser, and worker row.
